decisions.reason: The burner component supports the core gas radiant heater business at low cost, and with growth and slack there is no shortfall that would trigger cutting it, though its low visibility makes it the most exposed item.

As a multi-model flagship electric infrared line that fits the firm's electrification and decarbonisation direction, it meets aspirations in a growing market, and organisational slack lets the firm carry it while results develop.
The halogen heater has its own page and rounds out the electric portfolio for spot and outdoor heating, and absent any performance shortfall there is no reason to start problemistic search.
This industrial electric hall heater line sits close to the core offer and serves logistics and industrial halls, so it is likely to perform at or above aspiration.
The hydrogen-capable dark heater is a strategic flagship already in real operation, and with slack from expansion the firm will keep this uncertain but future-oriented line.
